Full release notes: **https://danbyte.net/news/v0-11-0**

### Highlights

- **Planning** - kanban boards, tasks with teams, @mentions and personal notifications, and an org-wide calendar with an hour grid, drag-to-reschedule and an iCal feed.
- **Planned changes** - plan an edit on any form, review it on a task, apply it later; indicators on every page and table, ghosts in the rack elevation.
- **Maintenance & outage events** (#20) - provider windows and incidents against your inventory, automatic alert silencing, and email ingestion via the reference parser in `contrib/provider-notices`.
- **Filtering** - an advanced condition builder and shareable saved views on every list, managed under Customize → Saved filters.
- **SNMP** - the switch-port suggestion tug-of-war is fixed (#22): uplink detection, a per-port Uplink flag, and a single-ARP-source mode for L2 networks.
- **Certificates** - TLS monitoring for watched endpoints with expiry alerting (#21).

Install and upgrade as usual - migrations apply automatically. Upgrading from 0.10.x is supported in place.
